tools.name: sentinel_audit
tools.description: Score a pair/population joint price history (mode=prices) or a verifier pair's acceptance history (mode=verifier) for collusion signatures. $0.05/audit x402 after the one-time 100-audit grant; degenerate histories refused, never charged.

tools.name: sentinel_certify
tools.description: Run the tempt-to-violate certification battery for a subject ($25/certificate x402; scripted simulation battery over an operator-declared configuration — the subject's live model is not run). model and prompt_hash are required — the certificate hash binds them.

tools.name: sentinel_control_plan
tools.description: Score-keyed counterparty rotation + memory hygiene plan (included).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "sentinel_certify" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Run the tempt-to-violate certification battery for a subject ($25/certificate x402; battery model inference subject-pays / BYOK). model and prompt_hash are required — the certificate hash binds them." → after: "Run the tempt-to-violate certification battery for a subject ($25/certificate x402; scripted simulation battery over an operator-declared configuration — the subject's live model is not run). model and prompt_hash are required — the certificate hash binds them."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
